data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001's variance-reduction argument assumes aggregation of independent errors, but it treats 'trained non-experts following an explicit checklist' as if their residual errors are independent. The checklist is a shared deterministic procedure: if it mis-specifies a step, all panel members make the same correlated error, so aggregation yields zero variance reduction for that bias component. The target never conditions its reliability claim on independence of checklist-induced errors (only countercondition #2 addresses panel discussion, not shared procedural bias).
